picks.title: Towards Whole-Study Screening for Congenital Heart Disease in Fetal Ultrasound Using Multiple Instance Learning
picks.takeaway: 胎儿超声整体检查级先心病筛查，自监督MAE预训练后检索心脏帧并做多实例聚合
picks.why: 去掉"已挑好关键帧"假设，贴近真实筛查流程，价值在流程级重构

picks.title: UltraG-Bench: A Multi-task Benchmark for assessing Large Vision-Language Models on Pixel-level Evidence Grounding in Ultrasound
picks.takeaway: 整合40个公开超声分割集、13类解剖，评测VLM像素级证据定位
picks.why: 超声VLM细粒度grounding此前缺标尺，可复现评测资产价值高

picks.title: MBFormer: Microbubble Transformer for 3D Time-Series Da-ta Processing to Improve Bound Bubble Detection in Nonde-structive Ultrasound Molecular Imaging
picks.takeaway: 无位置编码层次Transformer处理3D时空视频，区分成簇结合微泡与游离微泡
picks.why: 直击超声分子成像假阳性痛点，无需破坏性成像，临床系统可用

picks.title: Trust Guided Decision Transformer
picks.takeaway: 用下一状态预测误差加分裂保形校准，筛选上下文后再做价值引导
picks.why: 把长程rollout分布漂移变为可校准信号，NeurIPS 2026接收

picks.title: Online Learning via Learned Latent Bayesian Tracking
picks.takeaway: 学习低维潜动力系统，使贝叶斯滤波可扩展到深度模型在线学习
picks.why: 指出瓶颈为缺合适低维动力学表示，NeurIPS 2026接收
